Players Committee card image of [[ID9 Probe Droid]] (first published image; no errata mark), printing: “During your deploy phase, may use 2 Force to relocate an Inquisitor to same site and place this droid in Used Pile. While present with Seventh Sister, opponent may not target Seventh Sister with weapons unless this card 'hit.'” Uploaded unchanged.

Source: the Players Committee Holotable image set, file [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/1fa635b/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual13-Dark/Large/ID9%20Probe%20Droid.gif Images-HT/starwars/Virtual13-Dark/Large/ID9 Probe Droid.gif] as of commit 1fa635b “virtual set 13 cards” (9 November 2020).
